candidates.name: Coordinate tools and resources
verified_facts: OS distinguishes coordinate conversion from coordinate-system transformation and documents limitations of simple spreadsheet transformations.
OS advises using OSTN15 and OSGM15 when transformation accuracy better than 3 metres is required rather than relying on the simple transformation.
semantic_limits: A coordinate utility or formula does not establish source-observation accuracy; high-accuracy parcel work still needs the correct transformation model and measured input uncertainty.

candidates.name: OSTN15 coordinate transformation tool
verified_facts: OS provides the OSTN15/OSGM15 transformation tool for converting GNSS coordinates to National Grid and mean-sea-level-based heights and exposes raw transformation resources for developers.
At verification time the online transformation API reports that the service is unavailable.
semantic_limits: Tool availability, successful transformation or transformation-code access does not certify the GNSS input, parcel polygon, terrain raster or total vertical error budget; service failure must fail closed rather than invent transformed values.
